name: walkTo
description: Walk the vanilla path to a world position at a gait.

x.description: The target world x in tiles.

y.description: The target world y in tiles.

name: steer
description: Move along a world vector for a time, without a path, at a gait.

seconds.description: How long to steer in seconds.

name: attack
description: One swing at the target: done when the swing ends; read `result.attackStarted` and the target's health in the next frame; a target out of reach is approached first within the skill's budget, else `out of reach`.

name: interact
description: Open or close the door or window on a square, or loot its containers.

maxWeight.description: A loot stops before the carried weight would pass this; 0 for no cap.

name: equip
description: Equip an inventory item in the primary hand.

name: consume
description: Eat or drink an inventory item.

name: drop
description: Drop an inventory item on the player's square.

name: stop
description: Stop the current skill and every motor flag.

name: scan
description: Queue a full map scan of the squares within a radius.

name: rate
description: Set the frame rate.

hz.description: The frame rate in frames a second.

name: sleep
description: Sleep where the player stands until the engine wakes them.

name: aim
description: Hold the combat stance for a time, facing a zombie (targetId) or a bearing, while walking along a world vector (zero to stand): the backpedal. The stance walks only and never swings by itself; an attack sent while it holds swings from it. Released at its end, by any other skill (a walk or a climb cannot run in it) and when the target dies.

vx.description: The world vector's x component (0 with vy 0 to stand).

seconds.description: How long to hold the stance in seconds.

targetId.description: The zombie's online id to face each tick; -1 to face the bearing instead.

bearing.description: The world bearing to face in degrees (0 east, 90 south), used when targetId is -1; -1 keeps the current facing.

name: climb
description: Climb the hoppable fence on a square's north or west edge at a walk (never a vault): a walk to the near side, then vanilla's climb; a tall fence fails 1 time in s.

x.description: The fence square's x (the square whose hopN or hopW reads true).

name: bandage
description: Bandage a body part with a held bandage, ripped sheet or rag (vanilla's ISApplyBandage; a bandage already on the part is taken off first). A dirty rag stops the bleeding but doubles the infection odds.

part.description: The body part index; -1 for the worst: a bleeding unbandaged part (a deep wound first, then the longest bleeding time), else a wound under a dirty bandage, else an unbandaged wound.

keepMoving.description: PZA/1.5.3 (ruling P24-R): true to bandage while the running walkTo or steer keeps moving (vanilla's ISApplyBandage stops on a walk only for a leg part, index 11 UpperLeg_L to 16 Foot_R, and on a run for every part): the leg keeps driving at a walk (a run or a sprint is held to a walk for the bandage's length, the leg's gait wanted back after; a walkTo walks straight at its target meanwhile), the bandage reports its own act lines, done with walking true or failed stopped when the engine stopped it; rejected leg part for a leg part (-1 then seeks the worst above the legs) and aiming while an aim runs; with no walkTo or steer running it bandages standing, as false does, the leg-part refusal and the above-the-legs worst applying whenever keepMoving is true, whether or not a leg runs; the leg's gait is given back as soon as the bandage leaves the vanilla queue (PZA/1.5.5); the ride has no pathing and no stuck count: ride a walkTo only on an open line, else ride a steer.

name: rip
description: Rip a held, unworn cotton garment into rags with no tool (vanilla's RipClothing craft): refused worn, needs tool (denim, leather) or not cotton.

name: wash
description: Wash a held dirty rag or bandage clean at the water source on a square (a walk next to it, then vanilla's ISWashClothing; soap optional, the water's taint untested).

name: fill
description: Fill a held drinking vessel, empty (use container) or part-filled water (use water), at the water source on a square: a walk next to it, then vanilla's ISTakeWaterAction (the server moves the fluid). A river or a puddle fills TaintedWater.

name: wear
description: Put on a held garment (an item whose use is clothing) at its body location, as vanilla's Wear does (ISWearClothing, 50 ticks; a garment in a bag is moved out first): it replaces the item worn there. Refused worn when it is worn already, busy in a hit reaction or a swing, not valid for an item that is not Clothing or has no body location.

name: window
description: Climb through the window on a square (vanilla's ISClimbThroughWindow after a walk to the near side): an open or smashed one at once, a shut one opened first (ISOpenCloseWindow: a locked one opens from inside, struggles from outside and may lock for good, then fails locked) or, with smash true, smashed when it will not open (ISSmashWindow). Rejected not a window, locked (barricaded, or perma-locked without smash) or not valid (open but the far side cannot be stood on); failed fell on a fall, failed when the climb ended on the near side. PZA/1.11 (Plan 32 Task 6): a window reading smashed with its glass in (the map's windowPortal glass) is rejected glass unless clear is true, and the glass the act's own smash leaves fails it glass unless clear is true.

x.description: The window square's x (the square whose window record the map reads; the window sits on its north or west edge).

smash.description: True to smash the window when it will not open (perma-locked, or still shut after the open's struggle): noise, and a cut 1 time in 2 climbing through the glass; false fails locked instead.

clear.description: PZA/1.11 (Plan 32 Task 6): true to remove a smashed window's broken glass before the climb (vanilla's ISRemoveBrokenGlass, 100 ticks, no glove or held-item test, T101.3), the glass read at the climb's queue, so a window the act's own smash broke is cleared too; false refuses a window reading glass (rejected glass) and fails one the smash left glazed (failed glass): the climb through it cuts a hand or a forearm 1 time in 2 (#4366, T101.2). Failed not loaded when the removal's class is absent.

name: unwear
description: Take off a worn garment as vanilla's Unequip does (ISUnequipAction, 50 ticks): its body location empties and the garment stays in the main inventory, where a rip accepts it (a worn or held item is refused by the recipe). Refused none held, not worn for an item that is not worn, held for one in a hand, moving while the character moves unless the garment's location is one vanilla lets be taken off on a walk (the accessory locations: hats, masks, gloves, eyes, neck, wrists, fingers, back, satchel, scarf, ammo strap, elbows; a shirt, a dress or trousers stop on a walk). Fails stopped when a run or a walk stopped the action, dropped when the inventory had no room and the garment fell to the floor, interrupted when it stayed worn.

name: shove
description: Shove the target with the shove key's attack (setDoShove then DoAttack): bare-handed whatever is held, no damage and no weapon condition spent, strain on both arms (0.15 x (15 - Strength) / 10 of the sandbox factor, a third less than a bat's swing), and a chance to knock the zombie down, else it staggers. The target must be a listed live zombie (no target) within 1.5 tiles (too far: the shove's reach is not read from the jar, 1.5 is a conservative bound); a character in a hit reaction or a swing is waited for (PZA/1.12, Plan 34 Task 4, SHOVE_CLEAR: the press comes on the first client tick after both clear, failed busy after 45 ticks, the result's waited counting them); the character faces it first. Done when the swing ended and a frame after, with `knockdown`; `not loaded` when the player lacks setDoShove or DoAttack.

name: stomp
description: Stomp a zombie lying on the floor: walk to under 0.5 tiles of it by the auto-walk, then the shove's pair of calls, which the engine turns into a floor attack (the option autoProneAtk, created true): damage (0.7 to 1.0 + 0.2 x Strength) times the shoes' stomp power (0.5 barefoot, 1 sneakers, 2.5 army boots), strain on the right leg only. The target must be a listed live zombie within 6 tiles (no target) that reads isOnFloor() (not valid for a standing one); send it only to a fallen zombie within about 2 tiles, since the walk lasts 4 s. The target is re-read on every tick of the walk and at the swing: one that has risen ends the action failed stood, with no shove sent; refused standing while any other standing zombie is within the held weapon's MinRange (0.6 tiles bare-handed), checked again at the swing (failed standing): the call would shove that one. Fails out of reach when the walk does not close in on the target in time. A character in a hit reaction or a swing is waited for before the walk (PZA/1.12, SHOVE_CLEAR: failed busy after 45 client ticks, the result's waited counting them). Done when the swing ended and a frame after, with `hit`.

name: melee
description: The melee reflex (PZA/1.10, Plan 31 Task 2: the meet, the finish aimed at the head and the spent meet; first cut PZA/1.8, Plan 28 Task 7a): owns one zombie to the kill at the client's tick rate, each tick reading the two positions and taking the first reflex that matches: a hit reaction holds (no press; a press in flight is marked cut_by hit); a press in flight holds to its end, then its result (the press leaf, a knock-down, the no-progress run: stall presses that lowered nothing end it lost); beyond releaseR it ends lost; three standing zombies within 0.9 tiles (#4290), the target counted, end it handback (crowd; Plan 31 Task 15a: with two the nearer is pressed, re-pinned); a fallen target takes the finish (another standing zombie within handbackR ends it handback, one beyond never breaks it; the facing at the aim point (the head estimate with headAim, else the zombie's position), the floor swing within floorR of it with floorSwing and a weapon and not spent, else the stomp within 0.3 tiles of it, each once the look is within pressAngle, else the walk to it); a knock-down not yet on the floor is waited on; else the meet: beyond faceR the stance (a target not closing walked to), inside it the stance released and the target faced every tick, the swing pressed once the look (getLookAngleRadians) is within pressAngle of the bearing, the predicted distance at the collision event (d - v * (one update + 0.25 / CombatSpeed), v the target's closing speed over the last three ticks) within [pressLo, reach], the raw distance within the engine's own reach (the unmargined getMaxRange x getRangeMod, +0.2 against a lunging zombie: the press builds its own hit list, #4591) and the distance one update on beyond the weapon's MinRange; the facing written every tick, a press in flight and the hit step included; a press the engine refused (isAttackStarted false on the next tick) pressed again at once; the shove only inside MinRange; spent (mode shove, nothing held, the arms' pain over 10, or the endurance or tired moodle at 2 or more) the shove within shoveR, and after a shove that knocked nothing down the swing (a weapon held: Plan 31 Task 15a); a target not closing beyond the press's distance closed on at a walk. After a press no back step and no pause: the press again as soon as the swing ends. It ends done kill, handback or lost, never on time. Progress lines on every step change and each press leaf carry the step and the counts; the frame's act.step names it. Rejected no target (unknown, dead or unreadable), too far (beyond releaseR), no weapon (strike mode, nothing held). A melee re-sent at the same target keeps the stance; its end releases it. PZA/1.13 (Plan 35 Task 1): with the work arguments (workR given) the footwork reflex runs between presses (PZAgent_StanceWork.lua): where the meet would stand or face, a crawler within crawlerR with no standing zombie in reach is the target (the finish's stomp), and the nearest standing zombie inside the reach less bandLo is stepped back from along the clearest heading (the repulsion sum of the standing zombies within workR weighted 1/d^2, the crawlers within crawlerR x 2 weighted 2 and the withdraw vector weighted 1, turned by 0, +-30 to 180 degrees to the first whose squares at 0.6 and 1.0 tiles are neither solid nor blocked nor behind a hoppable edge, with no crawler within crawlerR and no fallen zombie within 0.5 of the point; re-chosen every 6 ticks and on a new nearest), cornered with none; with pile three standing within 0.9 tiles are met in the reflex (the shove at the nearest, the step, the next press) and never handed back; a finish's standing zombie within handbackR is re-pinned, never handed back; it ends handback floor at or under floorHealth and handback clear after 30 ticks with the target a crawler beyond crawlerR, no standing zombie within releaseR and no other crawler within crawlerR. A same-target re-send keeps the footwork's state and takes the new work fields.

mode.description: strike (the meet with the weapon swing; the spent meet once the arms or the moodles are spent), shove (the spent meet: the shove at a standing target, the swing after a shove that knocked nothing down when a weapon is held, Plan 31 Task 15a, the stomp at a fallen one) or finish (sent at a fallen target: its finish, then the meet should it stand; no weapon needed).

reach.description: The swing's distance at the collision event in tiles; 0 takes the held weapon's reach (getMaxRange x getRangeMod x 0.9).

shoveR.description: The spent meet's shove distance in tiles.

releaseR.description: Beyond this the melee ends lost (out of range), in tiles; a target beyond it is rejected too far.

faceR.description: Inside this the stance is released and the target faced every tick until the press, in tiles (the body turns toward a written facing over time, about 0.4 s for 90 degrees, #4689).

pressAngle.description: The most the look may lie off the target's bearing at a press, in degrees, above 0 and at most 180 (the hit list's dot from the weapon's MinAngle, #4591, #4681).

pressLo.description: The least predicted distance at the collision event a swing is pressed at, in tiles (the collision tests no lower distance, #4682).

floorR.description: The floor swing's distance to a fallen target's head, in tiles (the floor attack's line, WeaponLength + 0.5, #4679).

handbackR.description: Inside this another standing zombie ends a finish handback (why standing), in tiles; beyond it none breaks the finish.

stall.description: The presses in a row (a swing, a floor swing or a stomp) that neither lowered the target's health nor knocked it down after which it ends lost (no progress), 1 or more.

floorSwing.description: True to let the weapon's floor swing finish a fallen target (a floor attack multiplies its damage by at least 5, #4374); false stomps.

headAim.description: PZA/1.10 fix 1 (review-t2 F4, the controller's ruling): true aims the finish at the fallen zombie's head estimate (the frame's headX and headY: the floor attack's line tests the head bone first, x3, #4679), false (the default until the estimate's lying direction is calibrated on the first arena trial's shots of a finish) at the zombie's position, since a reversed estimate aims the line at the calves and feet (x0.05, #4679).

workR.description: PZA/1.13 (Plan 35 Task 1): the footwork's read of the standing zombies for the heading, in tiles, 0 or more; given (with crawlerR, bandLo and floorHealth), the footwork runs; absent (the default), the melee runs as before.

crawlerR.description: PZA/1.13: a crawler this near repels the heading hard (its term read within twice this), vetoes a probe point within it and, with no standing zombie in reach, is the target; tiles, 0 or more, needed with workR.

bandLo.description: PZA/1.13: the step back goes while the nearest standing zombie is nearer than the reach less this, in tiles, 0 or more, needed with workR.

withdrawX.description: PZA/1.13: the planner's withdraw bias, the x of a world vector added to the heading's sum at weight 1; absent with withdrawY (no bias).

withdrawY.description: PZA/1.13: the withdraw bias's y; absent with withdrawX.

floorHealth.description: PZA/1.13: the body's health (0 to 100) at or under which the melee ends handback, why floor; 0 for none; needed with workR.

pile.description: PZA/1.13: true to meet three standing zombies within 0.9 tiles in the reflex (the shove at the nearest, its knock_p on the leaf, the step along the heading at once, the next press) instead of the crowd hand-back.

backswing.description: PZA/1.15 (Plan 36 Task 2a): true to press on the back step: a press launched while the footwork's step walks (the band step, the retreat's step under the withdraw, the pile's and the crawler's steps: the auto-walk along the heading) leaves the walk held through the press (the leaf's moving_back), instead of stopping it on the press's own tick (false, the default: today's order); a work argument, needed with workR.

name: sneak
description: Set the sneak posture (PZA/1.9, Plan 30 Task 1): setSneaking(on), written once and held until the next sneak (the flag is one stored field that nothing clears on an attack, a shove, a run, an aim or a hit, #4654). Not a skill: answered on its tick by one act line, done with the flag read back, so a running skill and a held stance go on (a walk plays the crouched sneak walk under the flag and a run the sneak run, #4656), and a stop or a skill's end leaves the flag. Rejected bad args (on not a boolean), or not loaded when the player exposes no setSneaking or isSneaking; a raise is failed interrupted. At Sneak 0 or 1 sneaking makes a zombie's spotting chance larger than upright beyond about 4.5 tiles and skips the tripling within it (#4657); at Lightfoot 0, shod, with no trait and outside a room, footsteps carry 4 tiles against 7 and sound one step in four against one in two (#4661).

on.description: True to sneak, false (or absent) to stand upright.

name: probe
description: The facing probe (PZA/1.11, Plan 32 Task 1; a harness experiment for the zombie-free trial driver, never a planner action): for ticks client ticks, PZAgent_FacingProbe.lua reads the facing ring (getDirectionAngleRadians, getAnimAngleRadians, getLookAngleRadians, getTwist, getAimVector, isAiming, isForceAim, isAutoWalk and the bearing to the target) before any write, then applies the mode's write toward the target, one progress line a tick (result_probe_step), then done with the summary (result_probe) on the tick after the last. The target is the zombie targetId (when 0 or more; no target when it is not listed) else the point (x, y). Every member the mode calls is index-checked on the first tick (failed not loaded, its result naming the member); every flag a mode sets is restored on every end (done, a stop, a supersede, a raise: failed interrupted). snap_aimed and unaimed_snap at a zombie press DoAttack(0) after the last tick's snap.

targetId.description: The zombie's online id; -1 (the default) aims at the point (x, y).

x.description: The target point's world x when no targetId; -1 when none.

y.description: The target point's world y when no targetId; -1 when none.

k.description: turn_k's turn delta, above 0 (setTurnDelta(k); the read value restored at the end); ignored by the other modes.

vx.description: A back-pedal's world x: with vy non-zero, the steer skill's auto-walk along (vx, vy) at a walk for the probe's span, cleared at its end.
